lines.1: Off to the student council again today.
lines.5: Yashi glanced at me, then returned her eyes to her notebook.
lines.6: ...Apparently, she was at least doing her job as treasurer.
lines.7: But being alone with her made the atmosphere incredibly awkward.
lines.8: Not so much heavy as... prickly.
lines.10: I was terrible at this sort of thing.
lines.11: I had to do something about the silence.
lines.14: She was working while listening to music.
lines.16: She finally seemed to notice when I waved my hand vigorously in front of her.
lines.18: 「I'm not trying to bum money off you for a drink or anything.」
lines.20: Yashi was already poised to put her earphones straight back in.
lines.21: 「No, I just thought we could talk a little while we wait for everyone.」
lines.24: She was quiet, but she certainly wore her feelings on her face.
lines.25: Which meant she was now saying, "I'm working, so don't talk to me."
lines.27: 「If you're going to work this seriously, wouldn't people appreciate it more if you did it while everyone was here?」
lines.28: 「In the Princess's case, I doubt it matters when I work. She seems like the type to give you fair credit as long as you get the job done.」
lines.29: Technically, she was being polite, so where was all this pressure coming from...!
lines.31: 「Besides, I can't concentrate when the Crab and the others are here making noise.」
lines.33: She had me speaking formally, too.
lines.34: Forget dropping the honorific--she was calling you by a nickname, Kinu Kanisawa.
lines.35: 「I thought I'd like to talk with you a little.」
lines.36: 「I don't want to talk with you.」
lines.37: 「But don't you hate this atmosphere? It's so prickly. Let's make things a little friendlier.」
lines.38: 「...You want us to cozy up to each other? What a disgusting idea.」
lines.39: She gave me a crooked little sneer.
lines.41: But with a face as lovely as hers, that smile sent a strange chill through me.
lines.42: 「I'm only trying to make our work go more smoothly...」
lines.43: 「I'm the one working. Whose fault is it that things aren't going smoothly, "Senpai"?」
lines.44: She glared at me with icy eyes.
lines.48: 「Please don't speak to me while I'm working.」
lines.49: There was just no helping this girl.
lines.51: Maybe her parents gave her that name hoping she would grow into a soothing girl who brought harmony to everyone around her.
lines.53: she had become a girl with a personality like a pincushion.
lines.54: Normally, I'd just think, "What's her problem?" and ignore her.
lines.55: But Yashi did her work properly, and when dealing with other girls--except Crab--she behaved with a reasonable degree of courtesy.
lines.56: Even now, she sat bolt upright as she worked. There was something satisfying about watching her.
lines.59: She was starting to interest me.
lines.62: Yashi pushed her glasses up with one finger.
lines.64: 「You really do look like a model student with your glasses on.」
lines.66: ...If only she were a little friendlier.
